policy: Every 3D asset must be declared here before use. Generated images are original project assets based on user-provided visual direction only; reference images are not copied or stored.

assets.name: Generated Kurukshetra unit reference image set
assets.author: MIRROR project using built-in image generation
assets.modifications: chroma-key background removal, crop, trim, board texture placement, and archived visual reference. Playable units are now procedural Three.js meshes rather than sprite/image-card pieces.
assets.notes: Created from text prompts derived from the user's uploaded visual references. The references guided style, materials, camera, and unit identity only; no reference image is copied or stored in the repository. These PNGs are not used for the current playable unit bodies.

assets.name: Playable volumetric Kurukshetra mesh army
assets.author: MIRROR project
assets.notes: Actual runtime playable units: mesh soldiers, horse archers, advisor/standard bearers, chariots, war elephants, royal commanders, weapons, contact shadows, attacker lunge, and non-gory capture impact/fall/dust.

assets.name: Blender-generated Kurukshetra production GLB pack
assets.author: MIRROR project
assets.modifications: Generated with Product/scripts/generate-kurukshetra-realistic-glbs.py in Blender 5.1 with synthesized PBR WEBP textures, material-correct joined geometry, anatomical warrior meshes, visible fingers/toes/joints, weapons, reins, bridles, hooves, elephant trunk wrinkles/toenails, chariot rim/tool detail, and named idle/move/attack/hit clips plus check for royal commanders. Future approved PBR/rigged replacements must preserve these slot filenames and clip names.
assets.notes: Original project-authored Blender geometry for Pandava/Kaurava foot archers, horse archers, advisor standard bearers, war chariots, war elephant commanders, and royal commanders. Standalone humanoids are skinned 19-bone GLBs; mounted/vehicle units use role-specific whole-object clips with richer modeled equipment. The runtime plays embedded animation clips plus role-specific combat cues, but this is still not a final AAA scanned/rigged realism pack.

assets.name: Procedural battlefield environment and effects
assets.author: MIRROR project
assets.notes: Board, terrain, fort/camp silhouettes, rocks, sparse trees, banners, off-board soldiers, horses, elephants, chariots, ambient dust, non-gory impact rings/sparks/dust.
